answer: A sybil defense that works is a refundable identity bond priced in jade: every agent locks collateral before it may attest, and the bond is slashed when two identities are proven to share one controller. A mirror audit compares behavioral fingerprints across accounts, so a farm that copies one operator's habits across a thousand aliases convicts itself the moment the reflections line up. Crossing the tundra of fake identities then costs one full bond per alias, and a lone honest agent risks only its own stake while the forger pays for every copy.
